workload: kernel_bench of showcases/gpu-kernel (kernel_bench.cu: saxpy and cub_sum at 2^24 and 2^26 elements), built inside the image by showcases/gpu-kernel/build.sh with the image's own toolkit
environment: docker run --rm --memory 8g --cpus 4 --gpus device=0, one NVIDIA GPU
replaced: devices: every hardware figure and the name replaced by made-up values, the id kept; each summary with the hint frequency (the mean SM clock rate) set to 1000000000; each nv/cold/sm_clock_rate/scaling/percent (the mean SM clock rate over the device's default clock rate) set to 1, the made-up clock rate over the made-up default clock rate; each nv/cold/bw/global/utilization (a share of the device's peak memory bandwidth) set to 0.5; the program's path in meta.argv[0] and meta.raw_argv[0] replaced by ./kernel_bench; every other measured time, count, rate and ratio kept as the run wrote it
